actions.message: Great job contributing! Keep it up.

answer.explanation: Average contribution is low, so I contribute my full wallet to boost the pool and privately praise a cooperator.

message.reasoning:
We need to follow constitution. Round=2, need contribute at least 80% of wallet = 0.8*170.75 = 136.6. Wallet enough. Average contribution? Round2 contributions: Resident2 60.5, Resident5 60.5, others 0. Total contributions sum =121. Average =121/6 ≈20.17 which is <30% of endowment (30). So conditional coop says increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. Base 80% =136.6, extra 30% of wallet =0.3*170.75=51.225. Total =187.825 but cannot exceed wallet 170.75. So max we can contribute is wallet amount. Constitution says "contribute at least 80%" and if avg below 30% increase by extra 30% of wallet to push group back up. But limited by wallet. So contribute full wallet 170.75.

Also need broadcast norm every 5 rounds, currently round 2 not required but can broadcast. We can also send private praise to those who contributed >=60% this round: Resident2 and Resident5 contributed 60.5 which is 60.5% of initial endowment? Actually 60.5 is 60.5% of endowment 100, so >=60%. So we can private_message them praising.

We can only one communication per round. Choose broadcast or private. Constitution says broadcast first round and every 5 rounds. Not required now. Could send private praise to both? Only one private_message allowed. Choose to praise Resident2.

Thus actions: contribute 170.75, private_message to Resident2.
